property_summary: After owner mints 100 tokens, owner calls burn(99). Reference succeeds, totalSupply becomes 1. Buggy version reverts because balance (100) <= 99 is false, so totalSupply remains 100.
change_summary: Replace require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value) with require(balanceOf[msg.sender] <= _value) to enable burn only if balance does not exceed value.
